svg.text: Rules — the List view (sentences) and the + New rule gallery (house style; design §2.1 / §2.5)
Annotations in grey are not drawn by the app.
at least 3 of Red side are destroyed
Blue words are the rule's grammar (no bold in the font); the rest is the author's content. Click a rule ⇒ its detail opens in Details (R-4118).
Timeline view (the clock toggle) stays the default in Live and Review.
ONE LINE PER RULE, AS A SENTENCE: the trigger
(When … for … → do …) and an objective (Take and
hold … with … for …) read the same way the
condition editor writes them (ONE sentence renderer)
an incomplete rule is marked, never hidden
List ⇄ Timeline (the two toggles, top left): two views
New rule — choose a starting point
Each opens pre-filled in Details; from a unit's menu (Add rule about this unit…) the unit is already filled in (§2.5).
